info.name: AuthMicroservice Unified Solution E2E
info.description: Production-ready, self-contained Postman Collection v2.1.0 for testing the unified Auth Microservice across Identity, Users, and AccessControl modules in strict chronological lifecycle order.

item.name: 01 Unauthenticated & Negative Security Gate (401 & 400 Checks)
item.description: Goal: Prove that the system blocks unauthenticated users and invalid payloads BEFORE we log in.

item.name: 01.1 [401 Check] Get Profile Without Token

request.description: Verify that accessing /api/v1/auth/me without an Authorization token strictly returns 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 01.2 [401 Check] Get All Users Without Token

request.description: Verify that accessing /api/v1/users without an Authorization token strictly returns 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 01.3 [401 Check] Get Roles Without Token

request.description: Verify that accessing /api/v1/rbac/roles without an Authorization token strictly returns 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 01.4 [400 Validation Check] Register With Weak Password & Invalid Email

exec: pm.test("Status code is 400 Bad Request", function () {
pm.test("Response contains RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with validation errors", function () {

request.description: Verify that attempting to register with empty names, invalid email format, and weak password returns 400 Bad Request with RFC 7807 ProblemDetails validation errors.

item.name: 02 New User Onboarding, OTP & Login Flow (Chronological Lifecycle)
item.description: Goal: Register a brand-new user FIRST, test duplicate protection, verify OTP, and log in as that new user.

item.name: 02.1 [201 Created] Register New User (Step 1)

exec: pm.test("Extract userId and assert otpCode is NOT leaked in response", function () {

request.description: Registers a new user in the Identity module. Captures newUserId into collection variables and verifies OTP code is never leaked in the response.

item.name: 02.2 [409 Conflict Check] Register Duplicate Email

exec: pm.test("Response contains 409 status in ProblemDetails", function () {

request.description: Attempts to register the exact same email again to verify duplicate email detection and 409 Conflict response.

item.name: 02.3 [200 OK] Resend Registration OTP

request.description: Triggers resend of registration OTP verification code via email/SMS.

item.name: 02.4 [400 Check] Verify OTP With Wrong Code

exec: pm.test("Status code is 400 Bad Request", function () {

request.description: Attempts to verify registration OTP with invalid code '000000', asserting 400 Bad Request.

item.name: 02.5 [400 Validation Check] Verify OTP With Expired/Placeholder Code

exec: pm.test("Status code is 400 Bad Request", function () {

request.description: Verifies registration OTP with the placeholder code stored in {{manualOtpCode}}, strictly asserting 400 Bad Request and Identity.InvalidOrExpiredOtp.

item.name: 02.6 [401 Check] Login With Wrong Password

request.description: Attempts to log in with an incorrect password to verify credential protection and 401 Unauthorized response.

item.name: 02.7 [200 OK] Login as Standard User (Seeded user@authservice.local)

exec: pm.test("Save standard user access and refresh tokens", function () {

request.description: Logs in with the seeded pre-verified StandardUser account to capture valid standard user JWT tokens.

item.name: 02.8 [200 OK] Get Current Profile (/me) as Standard User

exec: pm.test("Verify user profile contains StandardUser role", function () {

request.description: Retrieves the authenticated profile using the StandardUser token. Confirms status 200 OK and StandardUser role.

item.name: 03 RBAC Authorization Gate - Standard User Forbidden Checks (403 Forbidden)
item.description: Goal: Prove that an authenticated StandardUser (who has a valid JWT token) is strictly blocked (403 Forbidden) from executing Admin/Manager endpoints.

item.name: 03.1 [403 Forbidden Check] Standard User Tries to Create a Role

request.description: StandardUser attempts to create a custom role (requires 'roles:write' permission), verifying 403 Forbidden.

item.name: 03.2 [403 Forbidden Check] Standard User Tries to Get All Roles

request.description: StandardUser attempts to read all system roles (requires 'roles:read' permission), verifying 403 Forbidden.

item.name: 03.3 [403 Forbidden Check] Standard User Tries to Create a User in Users Module

request.description: StandardUser attempts to provision a user profile (requires 'users:manage' permission), verifying 403 Forbidden.

item.name: 03.4 [403 Forbidden Check] Standard User Tries to Delete a User

request.description: StandardUser attempts to delete a user profile (requires 'users:manage' permission), verifying 403 Forbidden.

item.name: 04 SuperAdmin Login & RBAC Management (AccessControl Module)
item.description: Goal: Log in as SuperAdmin (admin@authservice.local), inspect roles/permissions, create a custom role, test SuperAdmin protection, and assign roles.

item.name: 04.1 [200 OK] Login as SuperAdmin (admin@authservice.local)

exec: pm.test("Save admin access and refresh tokens to collection variables", function () {

request.description: Logs in with seeded SuperAdmin credentials to obtain administrative JWT tokens.

item.name: 04.2 [200 OK] Get SuperAdmin Profile & Claims (/me)

exec: pm.test("SuperAdmin has all 6 core permissions", function () {

request.description: Retrieves the SuperAdmin profile and verifies all 6 system permissions are present in claims.

item.name: 04.3 [200 OK] Get All Permissions Catalog

exec: pm.test("Permissions catalog contains at least 6 permissions", function () {

request.description: Retrieves the complete catalog of permissions across all modules.

item.name: 04.4 [200 OK] Get All System Roles

exec: pm.test("Find SuperAdmin role and save superAdminRoleId", function () {

request.description: Retrieves all roles and locates the SuperAdmin role to extract its roleId into superAdminRoleId.

item.name: 04.5 [201 Created] Create Custom Role (Auditor)

exec: pm.test("Save createdRoleId to collection variable", function () {

request.description: Creates a new custom role 'Auditor' and stores its roleId into createdRoleId.

item.name: 04.6 [409 Conflict Check] Create Duplicate Role (Auditor)

request.description: Attempts to create a role with the same name 'Auditor' to verify 409 Conflict duplicate role prevention.

item.name: 04.7 [200 OK] Update Custom Role Permissions (Grant Read Permissions to Auditor)

exec: pm.test("Role permissions updated with read permissions", function () {

request.description: Updates the Auditor role with read permissions: auth:profile:read, users:read, roles:read.

item.name: 04.8 [403 System Protection Check] Try to Strip Permissions from SuperAdmin Role

request.description: Attempts to strip core permissions from the system SuperAdmin role, asserting 403 Forbidden via SystemRoleModificationForbidden rule.

item.name: 04.9 [200 OK] Assign Custom Role (Auditor) to Registered User

exec: pm.test("Role assigned to user successfully", function () {

request.description: Assigns the Auditor role to the newly registered user (newUserId).

item.name: 05 Dynamic Permission Elevation Verification
item.description: Goal: Prove that after SuperAdmin assigned the "Auditor" role (which has roles:read and users:read) to newUser, that user can NOW re-login and access read endpoints, while still being blocked (403) from write endpoints!

item.name: 05.1 [200 OK] Re-Login as Registered User to Receive Updated JWT Claims

exec: pm.test("Update standard user tokens with elevated claims", function () {

request.description: Re-authenticates as the registered user to acquire a fresh JWT access token containing the newly assigned Auditor role and permissions.

item.name: 05.2 [200 OK] Elevated User Can Now Read Roles (roles:read Granted!)

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200 OK (previously 403 in 03.2)", function () {
pm.test("Elevated user successfully retrieves roles list", function () {

request.description: Demonstrates dynamic RBAC elevation: the user can now successfully call GET /api/v1/rbac/roles (which previously returned 403 Forbidden in step 03.2).

item.name: 05.3 [403 Check] Elevated User Still Cannot Create Roles (roles:write Missing)

request.description: Verifies the principle of least privilege: despite having roles:read, the user still lacks roles:write and is blocked with 403 Forbidden when creating a role.

item.name: 06 Users Module Full Lifecycle (UsersController)
item.description: Goal: Test all 6 endpoints of the unified Users module using SuperAdmin token ({{adminAccessToken}}).

item.name: 06.1 [200 OK] Get All User Profiles

request.description: SuperAdmin retrieves all user profiles across the system.

item.name: 06.2 [201 Created] Admin Provisions New User Profile (POST /api/v1/users)

exec: pm.test("Save createdProfileUserId to collection variable", function () {

request.description: Provisions a new UserProfile entity in the Users module and captures createdProfileUserId.

item.name: 06.3 [200 OK] Get User Profile By ID

exec: pm.test("Verify email matches provisioned user", function () {

request.description: Fetches user profile by GUID ID and verifies email matches provisioned user.

item.name: 06.4 [200 OK] Get User Profile By Phone

request.description: Fetches user profile by countryCode and phoneNumber query parameters.

item.name: 06.5 [200 OK] Update User Profile (Syncs with Identity Module)

exec: pm.test("Profile updated successfully in Users module", function () {

request.description: Updates user profile information (fullName, email, phoneNumber).

item.name: 06.6 [204 No Content] Soft Delete User Profile (Deactivates Identity & Revokes Tokens)

exec: pm.test("Status code is 204 No Content", function () {

request.description: Soft deletes the user profile and deactivates identity credentials, asserting 204 No Content or 200 OK.

item.name: 06.7 [404 Not Found Check] Get Deleted User Profile By ID

exec: pm.test("Status code is 404 Not Found", function () {

request.description: Verifies that accessing the soft-deleted user profile returns 404 Not Found.

item.name: 07 Token Lifecycle, Account Suspension, Mobile Login & Password Reset
item.description: Goal: Test Refresh Token Rotation, Token Revocation, Account Suspension auto-revocation, Mobile OTP Login, and Forgot/Reset Password.

item.name: 07.1 [200 OK] Rotate Refresh Token (Valid Refresh Token)

exec: pm.test("Rotate tokens and save usedRefreshToken", function () {

request.description: Rotates refresh token for StandardUser, saves the old token to usedRefreshToken, and updates standardUserAccessToken and standardUserRefreshToken with new values.

item.name: 07.2 [401 Check] Reuse Old Rotated Refresh Token (Replay Attack Protection)

exec: pm.test("Status code is 401 Unauthorized (Replay Attack Protection)", function () {

request.description: Attempts to reuse the previously invalidated refresh token (usedRefreshToken), asserting 401 Unauthorized under Refresh Token Rotation security policy.

item.name: 07.3 [200 OK] Admin Suspends User Account (Revokes All Active Tokens)

exec: pm.test("Account status updated to Suspended", function () {

request.description: SuperAdmin updates status of registered user to 'Suspended', revoking all active refresh tokens in Identity.

item.name: 07.4 [401/403 Check] Suspended User Tries to Refresh Token or Login

request.description: Attempts to log in as the suspended user, asserting 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden.

item.name: 07.5 [200 OK] Admin Reactivates User Account

exec: pm.test("Account status updated to Active", function () {

request.description: SuperAdmin reactivates the user account by setting status back to 'Active'.

item.name: 07.6 [200 OK] Passwordless Mobile Login Trigger (Sends WhatsApp OTP)

exec: pm.test("OTP dispatched for mobile login", function () {

request.description: Triggers passwordless login via mobile phone number for seeded admin account (+20 1000000001).

item.name: 07.7 [200 OK] Forgot Password Request (Constant-Time Anti-Enumeration)

request.description: Initiates password reset flow with constant-time response preventing email enumeration attacks.

item.name: 07.8 [400 Validation Check] Reset Password With Invalid/Expired Token

exec: pm.test("Status code is 400 Bad Request", function () {

request.description: Completes password reset using placeholder/invalid reset token, strictly asserting 400 Bad Request and Identity.InvalidOrExpiredResetToken.

item.name: 07.9 [200 OK] Logout / Revoke Refresh Token

request.description: SuperAdmin logs out and explicitly revokes active refresh token.

item.name: 08 OAuth2 Social Login Providers (Google, Facebook, GitHub, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Twitter/X)
item.description: Goal: Rigorously validate all 6 OAuth2 social login providers with real Client IDs, live LinkedIn flow, and strict 400/401 negative security assertions with zero workarounds.

item.name: 08.1 [400 Validation Check] Social Login With Unsupported Provider (tiktok)

exec: pm.test("Status code is 400 Bad Request", function () {
pm.test("ErrorCode is Validation.Failure with provider validation message", function () {
pm.expect(jsonData.errors.Provider[0]).to.include("Provider must be one of: google, facebook, github, linkedin, microsoft, x, twitter.");

request.description: Submits an unsupported provider 'tiktok', asserting strict 400 Bad Request and Validation.Failure with provider error message.

request.description: Tests Google login with a malformed fake JWT id_token against the configured Google ClientId (543046172418-n1deithtt25s9tc177nagb5i7p2limt7), verifying strict 401 Unauthorized.
